lines: Imagine giving your one-year-old a head start so powerful, it's still working when she's ninety.

If she ever faces a serious illness, she can reach part of that benefit early. And after year five, a bonus lands on top.
At twenty-four, four years of college money. Seven hundred forty-four thousand dollars, on two hundred eighty thousand paid in.
From fifty-six, three hundred forty-one thousand a year, every year, to ninety-six.
By ninety: over ten million in illustrated cash value. Thirteen million in protection. From fifty dollars a day.
In force to age one hundred thirty-one. It never ages her out.
